title: EPA AirNow
description: Documented public air quality reporting (US EPA) for the Air Quality Forecaster capability area.
body:
EPA AirNow is a documented air quality reporting from US EPA. The EPA's real-time Air Quality Index reporting from thousands of regulatory monitors across the US.

How it works: It works by evaluating the Gaussian plume formula for ground-level centerline concentration at the downwind distance.

Documented uses of this capability area include city digital twins, power-grid planning, water-network operations, epidemic modeling, and disaster early warning.
